content:
The results of the recruitment process for the position of “Sustainable Urban Planner” have been announced.

The minutes of the jury meeting with the ranking of the admitted candidates can be found here

If you are interested in joining this Collaborative Lab, check out the open positions on our website. If you would like to apply spontaneously, please send an email to info@builtcolab.pt.
